summary.result: Un-plowing plot showed the highest runoff amount among treatments.
summary.background: Runoff, sediments and nutrient losses were studied under different patterns of paddy field management: (1) fall and spring plowing (Plowing)i (2) fall plowing for half of plot and spring plowing (Semi-plowing); (3) no-till for fall and spring plowing (Un-plowing) during the non-cropping period in the southern Korea for two years.
summary.method: Sediment losses from Plowing plot were 25% more than those from Un-plowing plot.
